title: Defect engineered Ti-MOFs and their applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01007H, Review Article
Guo-Ying Han, Mingshuo Sun, Ruixin Zhao, Qazi Mohammad Junaid, Guozhen Hou, Numan Zada Khan Mohmand, Chunmei Jia, Yiwei Liu, Pascal Van Der Voort, Lei Shi, Xiao Feng
This review systematically classifies Ti-MOFs by node types, surveys defect synthesis and applications, discusses structural challenges, and inspires new defect engineering pathways.
